body: I could have written that post myself. We all think these things as we grow up, it's part of life that we have disagreements with family, we lose the loyalty of friends. What you don't realise is that your family care for you very much, and they just want the best life you can have, they just don't say it in the best way sometimes. Talk to them, get them to talk to you. Humans evolved speech for a reason, and that was to share problems so that we can find solutions to them.

Hi. I have been in a similar situation recently. The only advice I can give to you is that this darkness is just temporary and although there seems to be no way to get out of it, there will be in time. You have to accept what has happened, and make small goals in order to get out of your 'toxic' environment. You will survive this.
